scope: Nanoflow date, parsing and number functions in the exported TypeScript client

native.toolchain: Linux MxBuild portable app, Mendix Runtime and headless Chromium via script/client_native_oracle

native_semantics: the client formats and parses with date-fns after rewriting the Java pattern: W, F, z, Z and X become literals, E/EE widen to EEE, S/SS to SSS, SSSS+ pads milliseconds, u is the ISO day of week
any other unknown Latin letter in a pattern is an error; an empty pattern is an error
formatDateTime without a pattern, formatDate and formatTime use the short style of the session language; toString of a date uses it with a four-digit year
parseDateTime is strict, tries the two-digit-year pattern first, fills missing fields from the current date and accepts years outside 1800-9999
daysBetween and the other *Between functions return the absolute distance as a decimal with 20 places; calendarMonthsBetween/calendarYearsBetween compare calendar components
division, sqrt and negative pow keep 20 decimal places (big.js), round uses the project rounding, numbers from 1e21 or below 1e-6 print exponentially
week tokens start on the session language first day; UTC week tokens always start on Sunday
formatDecimal, trimToWeeks and getDay are not available in nanoflows
fixed: TypeScript division of the client used 38 significant digits instead of 20 decimal places
nanoflow parseDateTimeUTC rejected years outside 1800-9999 and non-numeric patterns that the client accepts
limitations: only en_US was certified against the official client; other languages derive names and short styles from the browser Intl data
the Buddhist calendar of Thai is applied to formatting and to parsed years without certification
